summary: Forestry Commission tower in Greenville County, listed as removed on Forest Lookouts. A blog post names two other towers as gone and does not tie them to this entry. No build date found.

facts.status_note: Listed as removed on the Forest Lookouts site. The blog names two other towers as gone but does not link either to this entry; no source gives a date or describes the site now.

evidence.supports: Status on the Forest Lookouts site: removed
Towers served as the communications link for firefighters in the field

evidence.supports: Most tower sites: 10 acres, plus the tower and a year-round dwelling for the operator
evidence.quote: Most tower sites consisted of 10 acres of land, the tower, and a year-round dwelling for the operator.

notes_for_editor: Only the Forest Lookouts entry (county, agency, Removed) names this tower as a site of its own. The blog gives two descriptions, the Cleveland Tower north of Marietta and a tower on Firetower Road in Cleveland, SC; it is not certain they are one tower. Map-name databases (topoquest, anyplaceamerica) list a Cleveland Lookout Tower at about 35.074, -82.505, which matches the record, but they show names, not status, so they were not cited. No build date, operator, design or photo was found. Story is short because the evidence is short.
